name: io.github.howardchenghuang-dotcom/torontowalk
title: Toronto Walk
description: Free 3D walk through downtown Toronto in the browser: how to play, places to find, prices.

tools.name: get_game_info
tools.description: What Toronto Walk is, the link to play, which devices and languages it supports, how to start and the controls. Read-only.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en (English, default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Every place and experience the in-game album counts (Union Station, the PATH, subway stations, streets and landmarks), each with a short description. Read-only.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en (English, default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

kind.description: place = somewhere you walk to; experience = something you do (ride the subway, take a taxi); all (default) = both.

underground.description: true = only places below street level (PATH, subway, train concourses); false = only street level; leave out for both.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The game is free; lists the optional one-time purchases with their prices in Canadian dollars. Read-only: nothing can be bought through this server.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en (English, default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).
